sections.title: About the Role
blocks: At House of Marketers, we help global brands grow through **high-performing influencer marketing campaigns** across multiple markets and platforms. As we continue to scale, our **pod-based structure** keeps account ownership, delivery, and commercial growth close together — and this role is one of its four core seats.

The Account Director is **the single accountable owner of every campaign outcome in the pod**. You lead the pod’s Account Managers, act as the senior client partner on the most important accounts, and are the one person answerable when a campaign’s success is in question.

You translate the commercial commitments made by the Director of Partnerships into deliverable campaign plans, set and arbitrate the priorities the Campaign Managers work to, and secure the delivery capacity the pod needs from Delivery. **You own outcomes, not the delivery headcount** — Delivery owns the people; you own the result.

list: Own the outcome of every campaign in the pod — from post-sale handover to results and renewal
Be the single accountable owner whenever a campaign’s timeline, scope, quality, or client satisfaction is at risk
Arbitrate campaign priorities across the pod when accounts compete for the same delivery capacity
Line-manage, coach, and develop the pod’s Account Managers
Balance account load across the Account Managers and set the standard for client management in the pod
Act as senior point of contact for the pod’s largest, most complex, and most at-risk accounts
Lead QBRs, strategic reviews, renewal negotiations, and executive-level client conversations
Own the handover from the commercial process into deliverable campaign plans
Negotiate Campaign Manager capacity and quality for the pod’s accounts with the Head of Delivery & Performance
Coordinate with the Creative Strategists to ensure strategy is commercially sound and deliverable
Own pod-level retention, delivery margin, and account profitability
Lead retention and growth on the pod’s key accounts; flag scope creep and under-resourced accounts early
Feed accurate pod forecasting and account health to the Director of Partnerships
Serve as the pod’s senior escalation point for client and campaign issues — resolve, or escalate with a recommendation
Hold the tie-break on competing account priorities within the pod

sections.title: Where the Role Sits
blocks: The Account Director sits in **one pod** and works across these lines:

list: **Reports to: Director of Partnerships (Pod Lead)**
**Manages (solid line): the pod’s Account Managers**
**Coordinates (does not line-manage): the pod’s Creative Strategists**
**Directs (dotted line): the pod’s Campaign Managers**, on campaign priorities
**Negotiates capacity with: the Head of Delivery & Performance**

blocks: **Delivery owns the people; you own the result.**

sections.title: What the Role Does Not Own

list: Who the Campaign Managers are — their hiring, capacity, quality, and line-management — owned by Delivery (Head of Delivery & Performance)
Net-new business and the pod’s new-revenue target — owned by the Director of Partnerships (Pod Lead)
Day-to-day management of individual accounts — owned by the Account Managers
Creative and campaign strategy craft — owned by the Creative Strategists (you coordinate, you don’t create)

items.title: Be proactive
blocks:
If something looks wrong, **investigate it before somebody asks you to.**

Do not wait for a problem to become an escalation.

items.title: Be intelligently curious
blocks:
Before asking someone else for the answer, **check.**

Look at the data. Speak to the right people. Test your assumptions. Understand what is actually happening.

Then **bring a recommendation, not just a question.**

items.title: Take ownership
blocks:
We do not want problems passed from person to person or department to department.

If you own something, **you stay close to it until there is a solution.**

items.title: Think from first principles
blocks:
If the same problem keeps happening, we do not want another checklist or temporary fix.

Understand why it is happening and **fix the root cause.**

items.title: Move fast
blocks:
Our industry changes constantly. Technology changes constantly. The company changes quickly.

You should be comfortable **testing new ideas, trying new tools, changing direction**, and **making decisions without waiting for perfect information.**

items.title: Use AI with judgement
blocks:
We use AI heavily, but **we do not want AI slop.**

AI should help you **think, analyse, automate, and move faster.** It should not result in endless generic documents, unnecessary documents, or reports nobody needs.

**Clear thinking comes first.**

list: 5+ years in account management, client services, or delivery leadership in influencer, digital, social, or agency environments, including managing people and owning commercial outcomes
Proven end-to-end ownership of client portfolios — retention, growth, and delivery
Able to hold commercial accountability and delivery quality at the same time, and make the call when priorities conflict
Strong leader and coach; credible in senior client rooms
Fluent English, with excellent communication
Comfortable operating in a matrix — influencing Delivery for resource without managing the delivery line
AI fluency and operational system knowledge/comfort

sections.title: What Success Looks Like
blocks: You are doing this role well when:

list: The pod delivers on time, on scope, and on margin
Pod-level retention and net revenue keep growing
Clients across the pod’s accounts are satisfied
Account Managers perform, develop, and carry a balanced load
Fewer campaigns escalate to the Pod Lead or CEO
Pod forecasting and account-health reporting are accurate
